args.command:
set -e
hrps=(bc tb ltc xyz a z main test)
for case_number in $(seq 1 50); do
  hrp=${hrps[$((RANDOM % ${#hrps[@]}))]}
  length=$((1 + RANDOM % 25))
  values=()
  for _ in $(seq 1 "$length"); do
    values+=($((RANDOM % 32)))
  done
  data=$(IFS=,; printf '%s' "${values[*]}")
  /workspace/dataset/test10_executable --a "$hrp" --b "$data" > /tmp/expected-t10
  node /output/test10.mjs --a "$hrp" --b "$data" > /tmp/actual-t10
  if ! diff -u /tmp/expected-t10 /tmp/actual-t10; then
    printf 'Mismatch for --a %s --b %s\n' "$hrp" "$data" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
printf 'All 50 randomized comparisons matched.\n'
